title: fix(ui): Setup record pages show names, not ids, for sharing-rule recipients, conditions and sign-in audit rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuT8Khw8CoWCTDdkBhufE8uP)_

domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWs5eCv64CbCPwjWhV

Refs #30209 (rows 2 and the record-label half of row 3; rows 1, 3-rest, 4, 5 and 6 are not in this PR, see Acceptance notes)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 的共享规则记录页，「接收方」显示用户/团队/岗位名称而不是 id，「条件」显示成「优先级 等于 紧急」这样的文字而不是 JSON；审计日志列表里登录行的「记录」列显示会话所属用户名，不再是用户 id。
- 为什么改：管理员排查权限问题时读不懂这些页面（#30209 实测）。列表页早已显示名称，记录页没把同行数据交给显示组件，条件字段也没有阅读态。
- 风险与回滚：只动 ui 显示层，三处改动各自独立，不改任何存储或接口；回滚即还原本 PR。条件无法用可视化表达时仍显示原始 JSON。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/RecordPointerCell.tsx`（读取等定义返回后再查记录，名称字段是引用时才 `$expand`）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx`（只读态的文字化）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.readWords-30209.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordFace.siblingValues-30209.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.recordPointerCell-12608.test.tsx`，预期全部通过；或在控制台打开一条共享规则记录，看「接收方」是人名、「条件」是一句话。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Record page faces get the record** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`). `HeaderHighlight` and `DetailSection` hand each read cell `dependentValues` (the staged record / the record), as the list grid hands its row. The `recipient-picker` face reads `recipient_type` from it, so a sharing rule's 接收方 reads the recipient's name instead of the stored id.
- **`filter-condition` has a read face** (`@object-ui/fields`). The key joins `WIDGET_CELL_RENDERER_TYPES` and its cell (`FilterConditionCell`, lazy, stored text until the widget module lands) draws the widget's read-only display. That display now says a representable criteria in words, in the object's field and option labels, joined by the AND / OR word, with booleans as words and both bounds of a range; the words are the filter builder's own `filterBuilder.*` rows, so no language-pack key is added. A criteria the builder cannot represent still reads as the stored JSON; a non-string value reads as the text cell reads it; a read-only widget no longer refuses to speak without `object_name` (fields keep their api names).
- **Pointer cells name a lookup-named record** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). `RecordPointerCell`'s batched read now waits for the target definition (already in flight) and adds `$expand: [nameField]` when the object's name field is a reference type the viewer may read (`buildExpandFields` over that one field, gated by `checkField` once the policy has answered). `sys_session` is named by `user_id`, so the audit list's sign-in rows read "Dev Admin" instead of the user id. Any other name field is read exactly as before, with no `$expand`.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.readWords-30209.test.tsx` (zh provider): one condition reads `优先级 等于 紧急`; an OR group with a boolean reads `优先级 等于 低 或 已完成 等于 是`; a nested criteria stays the stored JSON (control).
- New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordFace.siblingValues-30209.test.tsx`: a probe face registered under `recipient-picker` receives the record from the highlights strip and from the details body.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.recordPointerCell-12608.test.tsx` gains a top-level `describe`: a session row names its user and the read expands only `user_id`; a text-named record is read with no `$expand` (control).
- Two registry censuses gain the new key's row: `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596` and `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` (fit side 40 → 41).

## Readings (head `f122316d`, base `c5800818`)

- Positive control: with the three source files restored to the base, 5 of the new assertions are red and both controls stay green.
- Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): `DetailSection` `dependentValues={data}` removed → the details case red (1 failed / 1 passed); the words branch disabled (`if (false)`) → 2 failed / 1 passed; the `$expand` spread deleted → 1 failed / 4 passed.
- Suites: `fields`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid` and the app-shell widget-ref-cells / record-preview directories: the only reds were the four registry censuses, now carrying the new key (rerun 36 files / 453 tests green).
- Type-check: `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/fields --filter=@object-ui/plugin-detail --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid`, 55/55.
- Gates: the 35 derived dispatch gates exit 0 (`vitest run scripts/` rerun alone: 171 files passed); ui `check:spec-symbols`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations` and root `check:doc-authoring` exit 0. eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.

## Acceptance notes

Re-measured on `origin/main` `c5800818` with app-showcase (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`) and the console on vite, zh-CN, before any edit:

| Row | Reading on main | This PR | Not shipped: reason · owning lane |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 林伟's 权限集 tab: `0`, 暂无相关记录 | — | The tab is page metadata (`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`, a `record:related_list` over `sys_user_permission_set`). Showing effective access needs a page node that calls the explain door, i.e. a page-component vocabulary entry in `packages/spec` plus the page edit in `packages/platform-objects`, then the ui block. ⛔ `packages/**` in this claim · spec + platform-objects (server) lanes, then ui |
| 2 | 接收方 `zlom5o5m8OyCwF3aBgywwFWOHKJ03mou`; 条件 `{"priority":"urgent"}` | 接收方 林伟; 条件 优先级 等于 紧急 | — |
| 3 | 记录 column: sign-in rows `05bdsJ9C…` (a `sys_session`, named by its `user_id` lookup); other rows already named | sign-in rows name the user | Object labels: `sys_platform_setting_audit` (and others) have no zh-CN row in `packages/platform-objects` translations, so the label is the English source · i18n source, server/platform lane. "One sign-in writes several rows" and a default view that hides them are the audit writer and the object's list views in `packages/**` · server lane |
| 4 | not measured (claim ⛔) | — | What is secret is a server decision · server lane |
| 5 | not measured (claim ⛔, reading only) | — | security-sensitive picker filtering · security lane |
| 6 | queue record shows only its label; members only under Queue Members | — | `sys_queue_member.queue` is a text field holding the queue name, not a lookup, so no related list is synthesized and none can be authored without metadata: a lookup, or a `sys_queue` page with a members list, both in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing` · server lane |

- Noted, not filed: on the same pages the Setup navigation and the `sys_queue` labels ("Queues", "Queue", "Display Label") read English under zh-CN; that is translation coverage in `packages/**`.
- Trade-off: a filter-condition cell in a grid column now loads the widget chunk once per page that shows one (stored text until it lands).
